title: NS-P14-Lean
description: A Lean formalization project for NS-P14, concerning a comparison of total Betti numbers of tangent cones of numerical semigroup rings with their interval completions over arbitrary fields. The repository includes Lean proofs, Japanese mathematical manuscripts, verification scripts, and audit evidence. The whole-P14 formalization is not yet complete.
